steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Configure project directory structure for Simple Calculator application.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Settings
steps.description: Set up Gradle build script with compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34, minSdk 21, and namespace declarations.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define package credentials, standard application metadata, app launcher details, and system theme references.

steps.title: Develop Layout UI Structure
steps.description: Write activity_main.xml layout employing a modern dark-mode design with clear calculation screen zones and an organic keypad.

steps.title: Establish Button Controls UI Components
steps.description: Declare numeric grid keys and mathematical operand keys with high-contrast color codes matching current mobile design standards.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Logic
steps.description: Instantiate MainActivity class declaring layout attributes, screen views, state variables, and click listeners.

steps.title: Implement Input Click Listeners
steps.description: Set click routing mappings dynamically for key inputs using solid Java 8 compatible mechanisms.

steps.title: Implement Backspace & Clear Logic
steps.description: Write functional methods to delete single character input elements and reset the layout screen cleanly on user action.

steps.title: Develop Mathematical Expression Parser
steps.description: Code a robust parser algorithm resolving compound input strings with custom operators into sequential values.

steps.title: Incorporate Operator Precedence Logic
steps.description: Write execution rules prioritizing multiplication and division over addition and subtraction functions for strict standard calculations.

steps.title: Handle Negative and Positive Signs
steps.description: Implement toggling mechanisms converting visual states between negative and positive prefixes dynamically on the active operand.

steps.title: Integrate Percentage Calculation
steps.description: Formulate basic percentage resolution rules enabling on-the-fly conversion of active values.

steps.title: Create Decimal Output Formatting
steps.description: Implement DecimalFormat parameters ensuring numeric outputs render nicely without scientific notation or dangling empty decimals.

steps.title: Enforce Exception & Error Handling
steps.description: Secure application outputs against infinite division and parser errors, outputting descriptive messages when calculations run out-of-bounds.

steps.title: Integrate Application Metadata
steps.description: Save application identifier properties inside local app-meta.json declarations.

steps.title: Code Verification & UI Audit
steps.description: Confirm layouts render with high quality across varying device screens, ensuring clean contrast ratios, font scaling, and alignment.

steps.title: Building Simple Calculator
steps.description: Compile debug application targeting the device sandbox standard built-environments.
